acceptance_criteria.statement: One approved locked manual guide covers integrated M4.1-M4.4 behavior and all executions append immutable Evaluation records.
Read-only ticket lookup proves authorization-before-provider-call for authorized, unauthorized and cross-Workspace requests.
Proposal and approval evidence proves exact target/capability/scope/policy binding, immutable material fields, model/system approval rejection and one durable concurrent decision winner.
Execution evidence proves current execution authority, revocation fail-closed behavior, one server-owned logical idempotency identity and no duplicate external effect.

Reference-provider evidence proves independent external state/idempotency ownership, both crash windows, strict stale-owner fencing, provider-not-found recovery and closed success/failure/non-terminal semantics.

Append-only audit reconstruction covers caller, proposal actor, approval actor, execution authority, immutable policy/binding snapshots, attempts, provider identity, observations and outcome/failure without private leakage.
Focused M4 and complete M1-M3 regression verification are green on one exact candidate SHA and changed-scope invalidation is recorded.
Integration readiness preserves main at 6312c4c4230032aa92ca5915803fcfaf564354fa and prepares but does not invoke the final feature code-review before Issue acceptance, integration and closure.
The known root-CWD Alembic round-trip failure is repaired without weakening or suppressing its test, and the root-CWD focused test plus full suite are green.

design_decisions.decision: Treat #79 as integrated acceptance and release evidence, not a redesign of approved M4 seams.
Bind every release assertion to one exact candidate SHA, locked guide digest, executed node IDs and sanitized evidence output.
Use observable provider-call/effect counters and exact public projection allowlists; prose or test names alone are insufficient evidence.
Keep PostgreSQL Knora workflow truth and SQLite provider outcome/idempotency truth independently restartable and reconstructable.
Classify the Alembic relative script_location defect as a required bounded integration-harness remediation owned by the worker.
Run PostgreSQL acceptance serially against the worktree-pinned 127.0.0.1 database endpoint and use fresh database time for lease semantics.
Record selective invalidation from the source-base-to-candidate scope manifest and rerun every affected accepted case.
Defer the sole final fixed-point code-review to the feature leader after #79 is accepted, integrated and closed.

invariants: Authentication, path Workspace authorization and resource authorization precede any provider lookup or write.
Only a human ApprovalActor may approve or reject; model and system actors are forbidden.
Proposal material, capability/binding/policy snapshots, logical execution identity and request fingerprint remain immutable.
Every provider write requires current execution authority and exact current compatibility.
One logical execution identity produces at most one external effect across concurrency, restart and reconciliation.
Provider not-found and indeterminate observation remain non-terminal and never fabricate failure or authorize retry by themselves.
Stale owners cannot record observations or terminal outcomes after generation takeover.
Audit and release evidence exclude credentials, key material, raw provider routing and raw command output.
The starting baseline is explicitly non-green until the root-CWD Alembic defect is fixed and verified.
The leader session does not implement #79 and main remains unchanged.
out_of_scope: Dynamic plugins, capability discovery, runtime provider registration, marketplace support or vendor SDK integration.
Changing approved M4 public behavior, lifecycle semantics or ownership boundaries without governed redesign/replan.
Weakening, skipping, xfail-marking or suppressing the known Alembic regression.
Executing the final feature-level code-review, accepting or integrating #79, merging, pushing, publishing, deploying, or closing #79/#74 from the worker session.

test_cases.statement: Exercise authorized, unauthenticated/unauthorized, malformed and cross-Workspace ticket lookup through the public HTTP seam.
test_cases.oracle: Only the authorized request reaches the provider and returns the allowlisted lookup projection; every denial returns the exact closed error and provider lookup count remains zero.

test_cases.statement: Create proposals across exact valid bindings and every target/capability/scope/policy mismatch; attempt decisions as human, model and system actors and race human approve/reject CAS contenders.
test_cases.oracle: Material fields and server-owned identities are immutable, non-human decisions are forbidden before mutation, and exactly one concurrent human decision persists with ordered audit.

test_cases.statement: Execute an approved proposal under current authority, then repeat with authority revocation and each material compatibility mismatch before provider admission.
test_cases.oracle: The valid path dispatches once with the stored logical ID/fingerprint; every denied/stale path fails closed with zero new admission, provider write or effect and the approved proposal remains accurately projected.

test_cases.statement: Race direct execution and repeated same-identity calls across the PostgreSQL admission boundary and SQLite idempotency ledger.
test_cases.oracle: One current owner/admission wins, same-identity replay returns one persisted outcome, different fingerprint conflicts, and exactly one provider ticket/effect exists.

test_cases.statement: Inject both crash windows, restart Knora/PostgreSQL and SQLite provider state independently, and repeatedly reconcile found, not-found, unavailable, timeout and malformed outcomes.
test_cases.oracle: Provider-committed truth finalizes without duplicate; no-receipt remains non-terminal until authorized same-identity retry; ambiguous observations remain 202; closed success/failure use exact terminal projections.

test_cases.statement: Race current, foreign, stale and changed-generation reconciliation owners with fresh post-lock PostgreSQL time.
test_cases.oracle: Current foreign ownership remains in progress, strict expiry has one takeover winner, generation increments once, stale owners are fenced and only the current unexpired winner records/finalizes.

test_cases.statement: Reconstruct audit for lookup denial/success, proposal creation and decision, execution authorization, admission, crash observation, takeover/retry, provider outcome and terminal finalization.
test_cases.oracle: Ordered append-only evidence identifies all required actors, authority and immutable snapshots while containing no secret, raw routing, raw envelope or private provider identifier material.

test_cases.statement: From the repository root, run the exact Alembic migration round-trip regression that failed in the starting baseline, then run clean upgrade/downgrade/re-upgrade to head.
test_cases.oracle: The focused test and lifecycle pass without changing CWD to backend, head is 20260824_0040, and no assertion is skipped, weakened or suppressed.

test_cases.statement: Generate the deterministic integrated release artifact and run focused M4, full repository pytest, Ruff and Compose verification on one candidate SHA.
test_cases.oracle: Every required case appears exactly once with executed node IDs and sanitized observations; all commands are green and evidence binds exact candidate, guide, environment and command identities.

test_cases.statement: Compare source base to candidate, classify every changed path and evaluate acceptance invalidation while checking default and integration branch identities.
test_cases.oracle: No unapproved seam/dependency/plugin/vendor expansion exists, every affected accepted case is rerun, main remains 6312c4c4230032aa92ca5915803fcfaf564354fa, and final code-review is only prepared for the leader.

Root-CWD Alembic defect remediation proof, clean migration lifecycle and head identity.
Exact candidate SHA, locked guide digest, environment identity, executed node IDs and green focused/full/Ruff/Compose command summaries.
